data.long_description:
Experience Hollywood-inspired luxury living in this stunning 2-bedroom apartment located in the iconic Damac Towers by Paramount Hotels & Resorts, Business Bay.

This corner unit offers a perfect blend of comfort, elegance, and breathtaking views — featuring two balconies overlooking the Burj Khalifa, Paramount Hotel, and the swimming pool.

Property Details:

2 Bedrooms
3 Bathrooms
Spacious Living & Dining Area
Two Balconies with panoramic Burj Khalifa & Pool Views
Corner Unit ensuring privacy and natural light
Fully Fitted Kitchen with premium appliances
High-Quality Finishes inspired by Hollywood glamour
Never Rented Before – immaculate condition, like new
Facilities & Amenities:

Resort-style swimming pools
Fitness center and wellness facilities
Spa and sauna
Restaurants, cafés, and retail outlets within the tower
Concierge service and 24-hour security
Direct hotel services by Paramount
Located in the heart of Business Bay, this residence provides easy access to Downtown Dubai, Dubai Mall, and Sheikh Zayed Road. Perfect for end-users or investors seeking a luxury property in one of Dubai’s most prestigious developments.
